Game Overview

In Nooby And Obby 2 Player, the core idea is straightforward: join the hilariously clumsy sibling duo in a wild parkour journey. Navigate tricky courses without touching the deadly red blocks. Help Nooby and Obby overcome their ineptitude using distinct controls, solving challenges together in a delightfully funny and chaotic adventure. Can you guide them to finish triumphantly?
